en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5) 17.21.
Vedanāttika, Kusalattika
Dependent on a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling, there arises an unwholesome state not associated with pleasant feeling by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling, there arises an unwholesome state not associated with painful feeling by way of root condition. [Dependent on] a pleasant...

Dependent on a wholesome state associated with feeling, there arises, by way of root-condition, an unwholesome state not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Dependent on a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling, there arises [a state] not associated with pleasant feeling,
which is both unwholesome and not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

And unwholesome states arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling, there arise unwholesome states that are not associated with painful feeling and not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of root condition. [Dependent on] a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling...

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, there arise states associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling, there arise states associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that are neither wholesome nor unwholesome... [and so forth].
Dependent on a wholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, unwholesome states not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise by way of root condition...

seven. Dependent on a wholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, an unwholesome state not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition... seven. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, there are fourteen; with respect to the predominance condition, fourteen ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, fourteen.
Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with pleasant feeling, a state that is neither-unpleasant-nor-pleasant and not unwholesome arises by way of the root condition ... seven.
Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with painful feeling, a state that is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and not unwholesome arises by way of the root condition ... seven.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and not unwholesome, by way of root condition... seven. (Twenty-one questions.
Under root and predominance conditions, twenty-one... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, twenty-one.
A neutral state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition, by way of object condition, for a state not associated with pleasant feeling and not neutral. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the object, there are twenty-one; with respect to predominance, ten; with respect to proximity, six ... [and so on] ... with respect to decisive support, twenty-one;

with respect to absence and disappearance, six. (The indeterminate root associated with painful feeling should also be treated as the indeterminate root associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.)
